title: Hebrews 13:11-13 — The Messiah was sacrificed outside the camp
summary: Hebrews 13:11-13 in English with key words in colour (blood, Holy Place, Jesus, His, Him, He), followed by the large conclusion: The Messiah was sacrificed outside the camp.

text.text: 11 Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
12 And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
13 Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
The Messiah was sacrificed outside the camp.
